messages:
Ishaan R: Heads-up: Ekko (hardware partner) requested a scoped perf/W + kernel flags bench for marketplace collateral. They want 50/70/90W caps, q8 and q4 runs, and a short reproducibility appendix.

Lily M: I'll take partner comms and the one-pager layout. can we standardize on delta_Throughput@75W and p95 improvement as headline metrics?

Diego P: I'll handle harness + telemetry. propose we emit csv with fields: run_id,node,batch,seq,quant,power_cap,avg_watt,throughput,p50,p95,kv_hit,kernel_flags. Also include ndjson traces.

Ishaan R: plan: 6 nodes, 2 control (vendor kernel), 4 test across kernels+DVFS. batches [1,2,4], seq 1024. 45-60m per config.

Diego P: draft cmd:
```bash
./partner-bench --model glint-8b --batches 1,2,4 --seq 1024 --quant q8,q4 \
  --power-cap 50,70,90 --kernel-sets stock,memprefetch,latency_tuned \
  --telemetry nvml,rapl,pmu --telemetry-interval 200 \
  --out s3://redwood-partner-bench/ekko/<run>/ --trace ndjson
```

Lily M: good. Ekko asked for a single-slide "marketing-friendly" stat but requires internal stats check first (p<0.05). I'll draft slide text but won't publish until legal ok.

bench-bot: scheduled ekko-20260510-01 across 6 nodes starting 2026-05-10T09:00:00Z. live logs at https://bench.redwood.internal/ekko-20260510-01

Diego P: provisioning done. BIOS and microcode pinned; control nodes running vendor-5.18.3. adding ambient probe capture.

bench-bot: job ekko-20260510-01/2 finished: batch=2 quant=q4 power_cap=70 avg_watt=69.5 throughput=10.8 p50=24.0 p95=49.2 kv_hit=0.89. artifacts -> s3://redwood-partner-bench/ekko/ekko-20260510-01/results/part-0002.jsonl

Ishaan R: early signal: latency_tuned kernel looks promising vs stock in p95. Diego, can you run bootstrap CI and post delta_Throughput@70W?

Diego P: running stats now. also captured kernel dmesg and perf maps for traceability.

bench-bot: job ekko-20260510-01/4 completed: batch=4 quant=q8 power_cap=90 avg_watt=88.9 throughput=8.7 p50=38.1 p95=82.0 kv_hit=0.76. artifacts uploaded.

Diego P: aggregates complete: delta_Throughput@70W = +5.1% (95% CI 2.0% - 8.2%). p95 improved -11.3% (95% CI -15.7% to -6.9%).

Lily M: great. I'll draft the slide with cautious language: "Measured up to 1.05x throughput at 70W and reduced tail latency by ~11%" and include reproducibility appendix. Sending to legal for sign-off.

Ishaan R: once legal OKs, coordinate a joint marketplace blurb sync with Ekko comms. Team actions: Diego (upload final CSV + schema), Lily (one-pager + legal), bench-bot (make artifacts partner-accessible after OK).

bench-bot: final artifacts for ekko-20260510-01: s3://redwood-partner-bench/ekko/ekko-20260510-01/final.zip

Diego P: uploaded CSV schema and example plots to s3://redwood-partner-bench/ekko/schema/v1.csv and s3://.../plots/summary.png

Lily M: thanks everyone. scheduling partner sync for Tue 14:00 UTC.
